Three new luxury hotels open in the Alps in December:

– The First Cortina, Cortina d'Ampezzo: 76 rooms and suites, by Pavilions Hotels and Resorts, on 4 December
– Saint Roch, Courchevel 1850: 37 keys on the Bellecôte piste, by @Maisons Pariente, on 18 December
– Bourbon Hotel, Courchevel 1850: 31 rooms, on 18 December

Saint Roch is the fifth Maisons Pariente hotel and its second in the Alps, after Le Coucou in Méribel. Interiors are by the studio Friedmann & Versace, and the restaurant is run by the Parisian caviar house @Prunier Caviar.

The signal: the Alps' newest luxury beds are small, between 31 and 76 rooms. Family groups and independents, not only the big brands, are betting on short, high-yield winter seasons.
